title: Confined Space Hazard Prevention Directive Art. 12
checklist: Activate explosion-proof mechanical ventilation (5+ air changes/hr).
Cut off upstream flammable gas pipeline valves.
Evacuate non-emergency personnel along dynamic floor lighting.
Mandate positive-pressure SCBA for standby rescue team.

title: High Temperature Workplace Protection Standard Art. 5
checklist: Mandate immediate 15-minute rest cycle per hour.
